scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,whats "dotnet run --project apps/api --no-launch-profile -- --environment Development" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/whatsapp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/whatsapp && dotnet build Autoescola.slnx
scripts.test: dotnet test Autoescola.slnx && npm run test -w apps/whatsapp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/whatsapp
